dimensions.assessment: Involves federal officials, state agencies, local entities, and applicable Indian Tribes participating in a resource study.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall conduct a special resource study of the Study Area.

dimensions.assessment: Only authorizes a study and report; does not alter park boundaries or property rights directly.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources of the Senate and the Committee on Natural Resources of the House of Representatives a report containing the results of the study

dimensions.assessment: Requires identifying cost estimates for future alternatives, but does not allocate a specific appropriation amount in the text.
dimensions.evidence: identify cost estimates for any Federal acquisition, development, interpretation, operation, and maintenance associated with the alternatives

dimensions.assessment: Narrowly applies to evaluating specific historic and cultural sites in Illinois.
dimensions.evidence: the Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site, the Emerald Mounds in St. Clair County, Illinois, and the Pulcher Mounds in Monroe and St. Clair Counties, Illinois

dimensions.assessment: Temporary study requirement concluding with a report due not later than 3 years after funds are made available.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 3 years after the date on which funds are first made available to conduct the study

missing_information: The exact cost to perform the special resource study is not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs a federal study on specific historic mounds in Illinois, leading to a report for Congress without immediately altering land designations or requiring major funding.
